detail.title: Architectural Foundations of Artificial Responsibility
detail.summary: Responsibility in autonomous AI agents requires explicit value grounding and architectural constraints. Current research indicates that agents can learn value systems from demonstrations, but reliability necessitates defined architectures for causal attribution and decision-making transparency.
detail.reason: Project proj-resp-formation-001 is synthesis-ready; this notebook formalizes the link between value learning and accountability architectures.
